channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: 'We live here': Fears grow in south western France over loss of train lines
item.description: Rail users in south western and central France have sounded the alarm bell amid fears they will lose crucial regional train lines.

item.title: Four arrested in south-western France on suspicion of spying for China
item.description: French authorities have arrested four people, including two Chinese nationals, suspected of spying on sensitive military data via satellite for Beijing, prosecutors said Wednesday.

item.title: Who are the French names in the newly released Epstein files?
item.description: Several French personalities have been mentioned in the latest trove of files to be released from the probe into late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Parts of Brittany and western France on alert for high risk of floods
item.description: Parts of Southern Brittany and the south west of France were placed on Orange alert for flooding on Thursday with torrential rain set to lash the regions once again.

item.title: French expression of the day: être sur la sellette
item.description: From reality TV competitions to a police interview or someone risking losing their job, this French expression is widely used by the locals.

item.title: What passengers need to know about France's new airline disputes policy
item.description: A decree establishing new rules on mediation and legal disputes comes into effect from February 7th, 2026. Here’s what's changing for affected passengers.

item.title: TELL US: How would you rate the internet speed in your part of rural France?
item.description: The rollout of high-speed fibre internet across France enters a new phase this year. If you live in rural France, please take a minute to complete a quick survey to let us know how you would rate your internet connection. Has it improved or is it as slow as an escargot?

item.title: Schools, museums, transport: The strikes planned in France this February
item.description: Mediterranean ferry services, city public transport systems, schools and public services are set to be hit by walkouts in France in February and beyond.

item.title: How to watch the 2026 Rugby Six Nations Championship on French TV
item.description: The 2026 Rugby Six Nations Championship starts on Thursday February 5th so which French TV channels will show the matches?

item.title: What you should and shouldn't do if your part of France is under a flood warning
item.description: Floods are the leading natural disaster affecting France, that regularly cause deaths to members of the public. Here's the crucial advice to follow if you are caught in a flood where you live.
